climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: One of Chile's five principal wine regions, covering the Bío Bío and Araucanía regions. It has three districts: Itata, Bío-Bío and Malleco Valleys.
